I really enjoyed Battlefield 4. The campaign delivers a solid and engaging story, with a well-paced sequence of events that keeps you hooked from beginning to end.

Even though I haven’t tried the multiplayer yet and I’m not sure how active it is, the single-player experience alone was worth it. The game offers a wide variety of weapons, adding depth even if I didn’t get to try them all.

What truly stands out is how the game plays with your emotions, especially through the tension and conflicts within your squad and against your enemies. The constant sense of unpredictability makes the experience even more immersive.

Overall rating: 8/10
The graphics still hold up well for its generation.

I missed this game when it first came out. Sorry for me! This is what Battlefield 2042 should have been. Gun play is good with good hit registration. Maps are well polished. Servers were FULL! The good news is the failure that's BF 2042 is breathing more life into this game as well as giving WW3 a real chance to shine.

This journey takes you from the outskirts of Shanghai to the Middle East in a succession of rather different landscapes and sufficiently spectacular scenes with the more or less clear-cut task of rescuing a mysterious masked man from the clutches of Chen, the mastermind behind the riots. Unfortunately, the several epic moments are stifled by rather trite lines of dialogue ("the sea took it"), obnoxious and flat characters, a rushed ending, and rather questionable choices, such as being the captain of the team but passively following the tantrums of one's comrades, or joining the different scenarios in an ineffective way via semi-static screenshots of the Valkyria, the American ship that will serve as your base, and a voice-over. The result is that the plot will leave more than one doubtful about the various characters, their purposes, and even cameos from previous games are exploited poorly and end worse.

Campaign - good
Multiplayer - bad. Skill ceiling is too tall, too many hackers and skilled players, making the game hard to enjoy for newcomers.

I’ve owned this game since it launched back in the day, across multiple platforms but somehow never got around to actually reviewing it. Its easily one of the best Battlefield games ever made tight gun-play, huge maps, destructible environments and an actual campaign that made me care about the characters. The amount of weapons, gadgets, and progression is still unmatched and even after all these years, it still holds up visually and mechanically. I’ve completed it multiple times and it’s one of the best Battlefield I keep coming back to. If you’ve never tried it or just want a break from the newer titles trust me, BF4 is still fire.

Battlefield 4 is a Polished Battlefield 3 and since Beta (til dis day, TIL DIS DAY) it did not disappoint with its primary objective. That is battlefield moments, a unique fix I can't find anywhere else.

--- GAMEPLAY ---
I really enjoy the combat in the game. There is a huge variety of weapons to choose from as well as being able to choose from different classes and specialising in them. As well as this the vehicle combat is really fun but some vehicles do have quite a large skill gap. Some players can make the game pretty unfun with this as they use a helicopter in a way that they are basically impossible to kill. Although it's annoying it's honestly expected at this point. The interactive world is really great. I loved going through the different maps and just learning all the variety of sections that have unique changes to them.

Although there are quite a variety of maps I do have my favourite as Shanghai which is definitely the map I have the most experience on. The various gamemodes all feel pretty different in terms of both objective for a game and the scale of the matches. I choose opt for "The Battlefield" as this gives quite a good amount of long distance combat with snipers as well as close combat while not having a huge map with too many vehicles.

--- Worth The Price ---
At the time of review the price is: £34.99
Worth the price? Yes the community is still really active

--- SCORE ---
8 / 10
